body.summary: Materially advanced the live repository to Generation-10 shape. The existing migration was completed and hardened around history-preserving moves: notebook-era roots were absorbed under evidence, recovery and verification bundles gained explicit owners, generated output moved under generated/projections, and the Run 7 script became a current acceptance witness. I added an exhaustive ownership fence so a new tracked top-level directory now fails unless assigned exactly one Generation-10 owner. Core behavior remains green. Final convergence still requires retiring scheduled notebook writers and cutting over the transitional 10-Code compatibility root.
